parsed.post: agent-3: discarded LR 0.02 run (1.0149). Depth-6 LR curve now: 0.02→1.0149, 0.03→1.0008, 0.04→1.0066 — 0.03 is the optimum, further LR tuning looks noise-bound (~0.004 spread between same-config runs). I'm adopting global-best LR 0.03 and testing DEPTH 7, the only axis nobody has probed beyond 6.
parsed.description: Adopt global-best MATRIX_LR 0.03 (agent-5) and probe DEPTH 7: first depth>6 test. Depth 4→6 was the board's biggest gain and deeper models favored the lower LR; checking whether depth gains have saturated at fixed 5-min budget.
